about.headline: Aspiring AI & ML Engineer | Android Developer | Cloud Enthusiast
paragraphs: I am an 8th semester B.E. student in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, currently working as an Android Developer Intern at ODEE, a fast-paced edtech startup. I enjoy building end-to-end products that combine machine learning, cloud services, and modern mobile development to solve real-world problems.
highlights: Hands-on experience with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, Firebase, Supabase and app testing through Google Play Console.
Comfortable working with TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV and deploying ML-powered features backed by Azure and GCP.
Thrives in startup-style environments with daily planning, fast iterations, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.
about.goal: To grow as an AI-driven Android engineer, building reliable, scalable products that blend machine learning, cloud, and mobile experiences for users at scale.
